title: Scribe Journal Entry
description: Schema for Scribe session journal entries. Additive-only: new fields may be added, existing fields are never removed or renamed.

user_id.description: Owner identifier — links entries to the user who created them

project.description: Which project this entry belongs to — validated against user's config, not a hardcoded enum

type.description: Category of journal entry. Core types listed; users may extend via config.

summary.description: Detailed narrative — no character limit. Write as much detail as the event deserves.

decisions.description: Decisions made: the choice, alternatives considered, reasoning, and constraints.

learnings.description: Things genuinely learned — the setup, the surprise, the principle, the application.

corrections.description: Mistakes made: observable symptom, root cause, fix applied, prevention rule, recurrence flag.

skill_area.description: Domain of growth — user-defined, common values: architecture, frontend, backend, data, ops, design, leadership

complexity.description: Honest complexity assessment. routine = done this before. breakthrough = genuinely new territory.

autonomy.description: Who drove the decisions. guided = AI-led. collaborative = real back-and-forth. independent = user drove.

notes.description: What this session taught about development — specific, not generic.

behavioral.description: Opt-in behavioral observations. Only populated when behavioral_tracking is enabled in config.

drive_state.description: What mode the user is operating in.

triggers.description: What prompted the current behavior — be specific.

cognitive_load.description: How many threads the user is juggling.

notes.description: Free-form behavioral observation — what a psychologist would note.

learning_story.description: Full journey narrative for Scribe-to-Scribe packet sharing. Captures attempts, thinking, and outcomes.

attempts.description: What was tried, in order, including failures.

thinking.description: The reasoning that led to the eventual solution.

transferable_lesson.description: What someone else can apply without repeating the full journey.
